payload.body: The configurations of the robot arm (prototype, product) and their product models.

The canary: a small, permanent trace chain through all repos that tests the tools.
Reports, BOM totals and coverage numbers leave it out. The elements it configures
are linked in product.sysml: the Pilot reads the model files in name order, so this
file cannot refer to elements of product.sysml.
The system of interest, its actors and its interfaces to the outside.
The features that tell the members of the product line apart.
The functions of the robot arm, free of any solution.
The logical elements of the robot arm and how they connect.
The product architecture of all members of the product line, with the allocations.
The space the canary board may take: box, mounting holes, connector J1.

The one product element of the canary: a board, a part and a bit of firmware.
It realizes no logical element on purpose (canary C0 skips the logical layer).
Real product elements realize a logical element (D85); do not copy this.
The robot arm project: a leader arm that a person moves and a follower arm that copies it.
The use cases of the robot arm and the needs they address.
The diagrams of the system model.
